nodes.title: Decode
widgets_values:
## Decode

Make sure to adjust the number of tiles and overlap to fit your hardware.
(fewer tiles will result in faster execution, but will require more memory).

### Recommended settings

| node settings (pixels)                     | resolved latent geometry        |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `512 / 64 / 128 / 32`                      | 16x16, ov 2 - 16f ov 4 |
| `768 / 192 / 128 / 32`                     | 24x24, ov 6 - 16f ov 4 |
| `1024 / 256 / 128 / 48`                    | 32x32, ov 8 - 16f, ov 6         |
| `1536 / 384 / 192 / 48`                    | 48x48, ov 12 - 24f, ov 6        |
| `768 / 192 / spatial-only`                 | 24x24, ov 6 - no temporal split |

nodes.title: Save video
widgets_values:
## Save video

Writes the muxed VIDEO. The original soundtrack is muxed on save (preview + HLG) when present; silent input gives a video-only file. Change the prefix on SaveVideo.

nodes.title: Inputs
widgets_values:
## Inputs

1. Load an **SDR** MP4 on the left. Size combos (`tile_size`, `initial_canvas_size`, `output_size`) are widgets on **Preprocess**.
2. Scene embeddings = fixed prompt (pipeline `--text-embeddings`) — wired to both positive and negative (CFG=1; same embedding), for both stage 1 and stage 2.

No free-text prompt boxes: conditioning comes only from **Load scene embeddings**.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links

**LTX-2.5 Model Weights**

Make sure to click the "Agree and Access" button the first time you download.

- [ Distilled model - ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Audio VAE - ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Video VAE - ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors)

- [ Spatial upscaler x2 - ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/blob/main/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors)

- [ IC-LoRA SDR to HDR - ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-1.0.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-SDR-To-HDR/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-1.0.safetensors)

- [ Scene embeddings - ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-scene-emb.safetensors ](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-SDR-To-HDR/blob/main/ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-scene-emb.safetensors)

This workflow uses fixed scene embeddings (no Gemma text encoder).

Same two-stage recipe as Dynamic 4K/8K, with the SDR-to-HDR IC-LoRA (`ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-sdr-to-hdr-1.0.safetensors`). SDR MP4 is mapped to ACEScct before the guide resize. After decode: tonemapped preview, optional EXR, HLG.

Put LoRAs in `ComfyUI/models/loras/` and the scene embeddings in `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`.

nodes.title: Generate - stage 1
widgets_values:
## Generate — stage 1

**Tiled Fusion Sampler**, 8 distilled steps. Tile equals the FullHD canvas (no spatial tiling). `SAMPLER` is euler. Sigmas must end at 0.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Generate — stage 1

nodes.title: Preprocess
widgets_values:
## Preprocess

**Get Tiling Sizes** and canvas resize live in this subgraph. `tile_size` / `initial_canvas_size` are qHD / HD / FullHD; `output_size` is FullHD / 4K / 8K. Stage 1 guide at the initial canvas. `use_streaming` is on; `use_tiled_encode` stays **false**. Audio latent = **LTXVEmptyLatentAudio** (works for silent videos); the source soundtrack is not encoded.

widgets_values_named.text:

nodes.title: Preprocess - stage 2
widgets_values:
## Preprocess — stage 2

Latent ×2 (×4 when `output_size` is 8K). Scene-embedding conditioning (same as stage 1), then IC-LoRA guide at output resolution. `use_streaming` is on; `use_tiled_encode` stays **false**. Audio latent = **LTXVEmptyLatentAudio** (works for silent videos); the source soundtrack is not encoded.

widgets_values_named.text:

nodes.title: Generate - stage 2
widgets_values:
## Generate — stage 2

**Tiled Fusion Sampler**, 3 fused steps at output size with spatial tiles from `tile_size`. `SAMPLER` is euler. Sigmas must end at 0.

nodes.title: Source video → guide frames
widgets_values:
## Source video

Frames, size, and frame count go into **Preprocess**, where Get Tiling Sizes picks a model-legal canvas (multiple of 32, `tile_frames` = 8n+1) and resizes the guide to it.
